en.content: Arrange the following conformational isomers of n-butane in order of their increasing potential energy :

options.content: II < III < IV < I
I < IV < III < II
II < IV < III < I
I < III < IV < II

en.explanation:
More stable less potential energy.

Stability order : I > III > IV > II

So

Potential energy : II > IV > III > I
